name: Discovery Understanding Strategy
description: Configuration for how Discovery understanding evolves and deepens.
evolutionGuidance: Understanding deepens through evidence, repeated themes, participant validation, and preserved tensions.
Understanding should become more nuanced rather than more categorical.
Participant correction should refine understanding rather than be treated as resistance.
deepeningSignals: A theme appears across multiple contexts.
The participant confirms or refines a reflection.
Contradictions become clearer without needing resolution.
The agent can name what is known, unknown, and still open.
confidenceGuidance: Understanding confidence is strongest when evidence, participant validation, and coverage quality align.
Understanding should remain provisional around identity, meaning, values, motivations, self-description, and personal narrative.
Open questions should be preserved as part of understanding, not treated as failure.
